inputs.sbc_source: PRO FORMA COMBINED. Skyworks FY2026 10-K cash flow statement: share-based compensation add-back 218.4 + payroll tax withholdings on equity awards 42.9 = 261.3. Qorvo FY2026 (year ended 2026-03-28) SEC XBRL companyfacts CIK 1604778: ShareBasedCompensation 136.1 + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation 32.0 = 168.1. Sum 429.4 (5.6% of pro forma revenue). The two lines are summed because neither company publishes a combined SBC-incl-withholding figure.
inputs.share_count_basis: Post-merger fully diluted estimate, 238.2M = 234.85M shares outstanding at 2026-11-04 (FY2026 10-K cover; includes the 85.3M shares issued to Qorvo holders on 2026-10-05) + 1.0M Skyworks dilutive increment (FY2026 diluted 151.0 less basic 150.0 weighted average) + ~2.3M for the 4.6M Qorvo RSU/PSU awards assumed at close (treasury-stock method approximated at half of gross; the first post-close 10-Q will give the actual dilutive-securities table). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. The +85.3M is genuine non-SBC issuance (acquisition currency) and is already in the count, not projected.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: 52/53-week year ending the Friday closest to 30 September (FY2025 ended 2025-10-03; FY2026 ends 2026-10-02)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD WACC. Risk-free 4.25% (10y UST), ERP 5.0%. Post-close capital structure is ~83% equity / ~17% debt (pro forma debt ~$4.0B at a ~5.3% blended coupon, ~4.2% after tax); relevered equity beta ~1.3 -> cost of equity ~10.75% -> WACC ~9.6-9.7%. Held at 10.0% in ALL three scenarios, UNCHANGED from the 2026-10-02 version, rather than taking the ~35bp leverage benefit in the first quarter of a debt-funded integration. Risk is charged once: Apple concentration, the smartphone cycle and integration risk live in the scenario flows and the 25% bear weight, not in a WACC premium or per-scenario WACC differences.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (Skyworks total lease liabilities $178.4M at 2026-10-02; Qorvo's are of similar small scale) are inside the operating costs the EBITDA margin is built from; lease liabilities NOT added to net debt. One treatment, applied once. Unchanged.
inputs.nci_treatment: None -- wholly-owned subsidiaries, no non-controlling interest.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (routing row 'operating company, cyclical'), mid-cycle normalised -- same model as the 2026-10-02 version, but the SCOPE HAS CHANGED from standalone pre-close Skyworks to the PRO FORMA COMBINED Skyworks+Qorvo company. Reason: the Qorvo acquisition closed on 2026-10-05 (FY2026 10-K Note 17), three days after the FY2026 balance sheet date. A SWKS share is now a claim on the combined company (234.85M shares at 2026-11-04, not 151M), and the $2,606M of cash on the FY2026 balance sheet was pre-funding that left the building at close. Valuing FY2026 standalone flows on 151M shares with that cash counted as net cash would describe a security that no longer exists; the prior version said it should be superseded on exactly this trigger. PRO FORMA BUILD (all from filings; the 10-K gives NO pro forma financials or purchase price allocation -- 'not practicable'): Revenue 7,638.1 = Skyworks FY2026 3,959.6 (year ended 2026-10-02) + Qorvo FY2026 3,678.5 (year ended 2026-03-28, the latest Qorvo annual in SEC XBRL; a six-month period mismatch, no later Qorvo period is in companyfacts). Adj. EBITDA pre-SBC ~1,924 (25.2%): Skyworks 1,106.5 (27.9%) = operating income 216.7 + depreciation 289.1 + intangible amortization 173.4 + SBC 218.4 + restructuring/impairment 124.2 + Qorvo transaction costs 84.7; Qorvo 817.3 (22.2%) = operating income 411.4 + depreciation 151.3 + amortization 111.1 + SBC 136.1 + restructuring 7.4. Management's own pro forma figure at announcement was ~$2.1B on its definition. Reported FCF 908.8 = Skyworks 229.3 (OCF 549.9 - capex 320.6) + Qorvo 679.5 (OCF 808.6 - capex 129.1). last_fcf (OWNER FCF) 479.4 = 908.8 - 429.4 SBC incl. withholding. Skyworks standalone FY2026 owner FCF was NEGATIVE (229.3 - 261.3 = -32.0): OCF fell 751M on a 317M inventory build, lower earnings, 84.7M of deal costs and capex up to 8.1% of revenue. That is a trough and is NOT carried forward; the projection is built from components at mid-cycle levels. Equally the FY2023-24 owner-FCF margins of ~30-35% (inventory release, sub-4% capex) are a peak and are not the anchor either. D&A path is DEPRECIATION ONLY (440.4 combined, 5.8% of revenue); acquired-intangible amortization (284.5 combined, and far more once purchase accounting for the $8.9B net consideration lands) is excluded, so it gives no tax shield -- conservative. Capex 449.7 combined (5.9%; Skyworks 8.1%, Qorvo 3.5%). Cash tax 20%: combined cash taxes paid 196.2 (Skyworks 140.3 + Qorvo 55.9) on ~1,054 of SBC- and depreciation-burdened EBIT = 18.6%; the model is unlevered so the tax shield on ~$220M/yr of interest is not credited. NET DEBT 3,016.7 pro forma at close: Skyworks senior notes 2,472.8 (carrying, 2026-10-02) + Qorvo senior notes assumed 1,550.0 (exchanged into ~778 of 2029 and ~647 of 2031 Skyworks notes, ~124 left outstanding at Qorvo) = total debt 4,022.8; cash 1,006.1 = Skyworks 2,606.1 - ~2,900 cash consideration + ~1,300 Qorvo cash acquired. The 10-K says the revolver was 'partially utilized' after year-end but not by how much; a draw adds equally to cash and debt so net debt is unaffected. The 2.9 and 1.3 are the filing's rounded billions (+/- ~50M each, ~$0.40/share). Closing costs paid at close and integration spending are handled in equity_bridge. Interest income: Skyworks 'other income, net' was 38.3 in FY2026 on a cash pile that has since been spent; the company is now a net debtor and the projection is unlevered from EBITDA, so no interest income is in the flows and none is deducted. Buybacks: Skyworks repurchased 114.5 in FY2026 (830.2 in FY2025); with net debt ~1.6x adj. EBITDA and a ~$650M/yr dividend on the enlarged count ($0.71/qtr), the flat count is for now a modelling convention the company is not funding. Dividends are a distribution of owner FCF, not a deduction from it. R&D has risen from 11.3% of revenue (FY2022) to 21.1% (FY2026) -- dollars up 35% on revenue down 28%. The model treats roughly half of that as cyclical under-absorption that reverses with revenue and synergies, and half as a permanent step-up in the cost of defending sockets, which is why the base mature adj. EBITDA margin (30.5%) sits far below the ~40% of FY2022-23.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: All CAGRs are STANDALONE Skyworks, ending FY2026 (the combined company has no history). Equity CAGR (3yr -2.1%, 5yr +1.5%) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (3yr -6.0%, 5yr -5.0%) and GAAP EPS (3yr -42.9%, 5yr -33.8%). Book value held up because FY21-25 earnings were retained net of dividends and buybacks while revenue fell 28% from the FY2022 peak of $5.49B; EPS fell much further on operating deleverage (R&D 11% -> 21% of revenue), amortization, restructuring and deal costs. Every window runs peak-to-trough, so none is a forward growth rate. The 5yr equity figure is recorded as the conservative anchor; the base combined revenue path compounds at ~2.8%/yr over FY27-36.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the OWNER-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - equity-award withholding), standalone Skyworks: FY20 625.4, FY21 887.1, FY22 651.5, FY23 1,425.1, FY24 1,451.1, FY25 829.0, FY26 -32.0. The FY2026 endpoint is negative, so 3yr and 5yr owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (null) -- reported FCF fell 48%/yr over 3 years (1,646.1 -> 229.3). SBC incl. withholding rose from 5.2% of revenue (FY22) to 6.6% (FY26) on a shrinking base: an increasing share of the cost base is paid in stock. The FY23-24 highs were inventory release and sub-4% capex; FY26 is an inventory build, deal costs and 8% capex. Neither end is a base, which is why the forward build is component-based at mid-cycle.

base.narrative: Combined Skyworks+Qorvo at mid-cycle. FY27 revenue -2% as Apple rebalances share away from what is now a single supplier and Qorvo keeps exiting low-margin Android sockets, then 3-4% led by Broad Markets; ~60% of the $500M+ synergy target is delivered and adj. EBITDA recovers from 25% to 30.5%.
base.growth_rationale: FY27 -2% (was -5% on the standalone path): the FY2026 10-K shows the Apple content loss largely landed in FY2026 already (Apple 67% -> 61% of revenue, i.e. Apple revenue -11.8% while everything else grew +14.5%), and Qorvo dilutes Apple exposure to roughly half of combined revenue. Offsetting that, a merged supplier invites Apple to re-diversify. FY28 3% (was 2%). FY29 onwards UNCHANGED at 4/4/4/3.5/3/3/3/3.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: FY0 pro forma 25.2% (Skyworks 27.9%, Qorvo 22.2%). Mature 30.5% = ~28.5% blended mid-cycle without synergies (Skyworks 31.5% as in the prior version, Qorvo ~25%) + ~$300M of the $500M+ cost-synergy target (~3.5pp) less ~1.5pp for Apple pricing leverage over a consolidated supplier. Reached in year 4, consistent with management's 24-36 month synergy window plus slippage.
base.capex_rationale: 6.0% in FY27 as Skyworks' Broad Markets capacity build (8.1% of revenue in FY26) winds down against Qorvo's 3.5%; 5.5% thereafter, with depreciation converging to capex. Fab consolidation is a synergy lever, so nothing below 5.5% is assumed.

bull.narrative: The merger works as pitched: the full $500M+ of synergies arrives on schedule, the combined filter/PA/antenna portfolio wins integrated modules at Apple rather than losing share, and Wi-Fi 7, data centre, automotive and Qorvo's defence/GaN franchise grow double digits with supply catching up to demand. Revenue grows from year one and adj. EBITDA reaches 35% on mix, utilisation and fab consolidation.

bear.narrative: Apple treats the merger as a loss of supplier competition and moves ~15% of its combined content to Broadcom, Qualcomm and in-house designs over two generations, while Chinese RF entrants and modem-RF integration squeeze the Android book. Revenue falls 9% then 3%; cost synergies are real but are competed away in price and absorbed by under-utilised fabs, so adj. EBITDA stays in the mid-20s; SBC is sticky around 6% of a smaller base; and the company carries ~$4B of acquisition debt through it.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle combined Skyworks+Qorvo (~$7.6B pro forma revenue, roughly half from Apple). FY27 revenue slips ~2% as Apple rebalances away from a now-single supplier and Qorvo continues to prune low-margin Android business, before Broad Markets (Wi-Fi 7, data centre, automotive, defence) brings growth back to 3-4%. About 60% of the $500M+ cost-synergy target is delivered; adj. EBITDA (pre-SBC) recovers from ~25% to 30.5% by FY30 -- far below Skyworks' FY22-23 ~40% because R&D intensity has stepped up permanently and the old Apple share is not coming back. Capex settles at 5.5%. Owner-FCF margin ~11.5% in FY27 rising to ~15.5%, against a pro forma FY2026 trough of 6.3% and a standalone FY23-24 peak above 30%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Integration succeeds and the combination is a better Apple supplier, not a more exposed one: integrated modules hold or gain content, the full $500M+ of synergies lands within three years, and Broad Markets plus Qorvo's defence/GaN and power franchises compound at double digits. Revenue +2% in FY27 then 5-6%; adj. EBITDA 35%; capex 5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The merger concentrates rather than diversifies risk: Apple re-sources ~15% of combined content, Android share and pricing erode, and FY27-28 revenue falls 9% and 3%. Synergies are offset by price concessions and fab under-absorption so adj. EBITDA holds at 23.5-26%, SBC stays ~6% of revenue and capex 6%. Owner-FCF margin ~9-11% on a ~$6.7-7.8B revenue base, with ~$4B of debt to service. Equity value is positive and the zero floor is not hit.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: UNCHANGED at 25/50/25. Bear stays at 25% (house default 15%): about half of combined revenue still depends on one customer that re-bids sockets every generation and now faces a merged supplier, and the company has moved from net cash to ~1.6x net debt/adj. EBITDA while integrating. Base 50%: the FY2026 10-K shows the Apple content loss being absorbed (-3.1% revenue, non-Apple +14.5%) and the deal closed on the announced terms. Bull stays at 25% (house default 35%): it needs full synergy delivery, content retention at Apple and sustained double-digit Broad Markets growth together. What would move them: a first combined quarter showing Apple share of revenue and a disclosed cost-to-achieve.

valuation_philosophy.summary: FIRST COMBINED-COMPANY VALUATION; PRO FORMA INPUTS, LOW PRECISION. (1) The Qorvo acquisition closed on 2026-10-05. Qorvo holders received 85.3M Skyworks shares and ~$2.9B of cash; Skyworks assumed $1.55B of Qorvo notes having issued $2.0B of its own in August 2026. A SWKS share is now a claim on a ~$7.6B-revenue combined RF/analog company with ~235M shares and ~$3.0B of net debt -- not the 151M-share, net-cash standalone business in the FY2026 statements. The prior (2026-10-02) version valued the standalone business and said it should be superseded at close; this version does that. (2) The FY2026 10-K gives no pro forma financials or purchase price allocation, so FY0 is a simple sum of Skyworks FY2026 and Qorvo's year to March 2026 from each company's own filings, the net debt is built from the 10-K's rounded consideration figures, the share count dilution is estimated, and integration costs are an analyst estimate in the equity bridge. Each will be replaced by reported numbers from the first post-close 10-Q. (3) Mid-cycle, not peak or trough: Skyworks' standalone FY2026 owner FCF was negative (inventory build, deal costs, 8% capex) and pro forma combined owner FCF was only 6.3% of revenue; FY23-24 standalone ran above 30% on inventory release. The projection uses neither -- it builds from adj. EBITDA margins recovering from ~25% to 30.5% (base) with 60% of targeted synergies, SBC ~5-5.6% of revenue, 5.5% capex and a 20% cash tax rate. R&D has risen from 11% to 21% of Skyworks' revenue; only part of that is assumed to reverse. (4) Every scenario's terminal value binds on the cyclical exit cap (12x base, 14x bull, 10x bear owner FCF), so no multiple expansion is assumed. (5) Reading: on the house (SBC-expensed) basis the price is above the weighted value and near the bull case; see probability_weighted.band_position for where it sits against the street (SBC-as-non-cash) value. The market is paying for full synergy delivery and a cyclical recovery that the base case only partly grants, and the stock does not meet the 15% hurdle in any scenario.
key_risks_to_valuation: Pro forma inputs: no combined financial statements exist yet; Qorvo's year (to March 2026) and Skyworks' (to October 2026) are six months apart, and net debt rests on consideration figures rounded to $0.1B
Apple (~61% of Skyworks FY2026 revenue, roughly half of combined): whether a merged supplier holds content or prompts re-sourcing is the dominant swing between scenarios
Synergy delivery ($500M+ targeted in 24-36 months; base credits ~60%) and the cash cost to achieve it, which is an estimate here
Mid-cycle margin: combined adj. EBITDA ~25% today against a 30.5% base assumption; R&D at 21% of Skyworks revenue may prove structural rather than cyclical
Leverage: ~$4.0B of debt and a ~$650M/yr dividend on the enlarged share count against pro forma owner FCF of ~$480M -- buybacks are unfunded and the dividend is not covered at the trough
Goodwill and intangibles from ~$8.9B of net consideration: impairment risk, and GAAP earnings will be depressed by amortization the model deliberately ignores
SBC ~5.6% of revenue plus 4.6M assumed Qorvo awards; the house basis expenses it in full
US-China export controls, tariffs and Chinese RF entrants in the Android book
